'''Kadas'sa'Nikto''', or '''Green Nikto''', were a [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]]<ref name="The Essential Guide to Alien Species" /> which originated in the milder climatic regions of [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]], such as the forests and the seacoasts. Their scaly faces had small facial horns surrounding the eyes and on the chin. Their main distinguishing feature was the long climbing claws on their hands, which could also be used in combat.

==Kadas'sa'Nikto in the galaxy==
By the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], many Kadas'sa'Nikto were members of the [[Black Vulkars/Legends|Black Vulkar]] street gang on the planet [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. [[Redros]] was the gang's [[Swooper/Legends|swoop racer]] who completed against [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], a former [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who believed<ref name="KoTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> himself<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> to be a soldier for the Republic during the [[Tarisian Season Opener]]<ref name="KoTOR" /> in [[3956 BBY]].<ref name="KOTOR1 Date">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' to [[3956 BBY]].</ref> That same year, a Kadas'sa'Nikto player of the card game [[Pazaak/Legends|pazaak]], [[Jolan Aphett]], traveled [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] looking to be challenged in the game, visiting [[Ahto City/Legends|Ahto City]] on the planet [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]].<ref name="KoTOR" /> 

During the [[Dark Wars]]<ref name="KoTORII" /> in [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="KOTOR2 Date">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' to [[3951 BBY]].</ref> [[M'sadaar]], a Kadas'sa'Nikto who competitively raced on the planet [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], spent time in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]].<ref name="KoTORII">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> Also in that year, three Kadas'sa'Nikto were crew members of the ''[[Lunar Shadow]]'', a ship stuck on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="KoTORII" />

During the early [[Era of Rebellion/Legends|Rebellion era]], the Kadas'sa'Nikto male [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Wooof/Legends|Wooof]] found himself in debt to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] and began to work for him as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="Wooof">{{Topps|set=2013 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Series 2|cardname=Wooof|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/93283/cid/6569393/2013-Topps-Star-Wars:-Galactic-Files-Series-2-368-Wooof}}</ref> [[Yotts Orren]] was another Nikto smuggler employed by the Hutt who worked as part of his crew on his [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]],<ref name="OrrenCCG">{{CCG|set=Tatooine Limited|cardname=Yotts Orren}}</ref> the ''[[Khetanna/Legends|Khetanna]]''.<ref name="CrossSections>''[[Star Wars: Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> The Kadas'sa'Nikto [[Klaatu/Legends|Klaatu]] was a [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] in charge of repairing the Hutt's [[Skiff/Legends|skiffs]].<ref name="KlaatuCCG">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Klaatu}}</ref>
